d: Video description: A young boy growing up in Madras once filled entire notebooks with strange formulas that no one around him could understand. Years later, those same notes would shock the greatest mathematicians in England and open new doors in number theory, physics and modern science. This video explores how Srinivasa Ramanujan went from a small town in South India to becoming one of the most brilliant mathematical minds ever known. His life shows what can happen when raw talent finally meets the right opportunity.
